notes.title: Christmas Runner is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Christmas Runner has been released.
I developed this PC game by myself, and I'm still working on it. Welcome to the steam forum to give me your suggestions and report bugs.
The game script has also been released, and everyone who is interested can modify it (including rules, data and art).
The game is run by a scripting engine. You can run the script directly without compiling it.
Thank you very much.
